title: Global local-road governance and asset-management evidence register
scope: Official, primary-source evidence on district, urban, rural and access-road governance. Every configured country remains in the country matrix; countries without reviewed evidence are explicitly marked Not yet source-verified.

principles.measure: All-season access, travel reliability, safety and access to services
Lifecycle cost, asset value, maintenance backlog and intervention timing
principles.technique: Lifecycle planning, deterioration modelling and preventive-maintenance programming

principles.measure: Criticality, vulnerability, disruption and recovery performance
principles.technique: Risk registers, climate screening and resilience scenarios

principles.measure: Inventory completeness, condition, traffic, structures and performance trends
principles.technique: GIS linear referencing, condition surveys, traffic counts and performance monitoring

principles.measure: Inputs, outputs, outcomes, efficiency and delivery against plan
principles.technique: SMART indicators, dashboards, audits and transparent reporting

records.governance_model: Central ministry policy with district, urban and community-access road implementing responsibilities
records.local_road_manager: District and urban authorities under the national DUCAR framework
records.financing_mechanism: Public road-sector programmes and local-government implementation
records.asset_management_principles: Unified link inventory; administrative accountability; condition, traffic, structures and accessibility evidence
records.performance_measures: Confirmed inventory length, links and districts; affected length by asset and service metric
records.tools_and_techniques: GIS link register, spatial joins, condition and traffic integration, prioritisation and database controls
records.source_title: Uganda Ministry of Works and Transport

records.governance_model: Specialised feeder-road and urban-road departments under the roads ministry, with district operations and decentralisation
records.lead_institution: Ministry of Roads and Highways / Department of Feeder Roads
records.local_road_manager: Department of Feeder Roads regional and district operations; district assemblies under decentralisation
records.financing_mechanism: Road Fund and programme financing, including performance-based maintenance
records.asset_management_principles: Safe all-weather rural access at optimum cost; inventory-led decisions; accountability and accessibility
records.performance_measures: Rural communities within 2 km; planned maintenance delivered; resilient road length; grievance and reporting timeliness
records.tools_and_techniques: WIGRAMS web GIS, annual asset collection, labour-based technology and performance-based contracts

records.governance_model: Road classes assigned to specialised national authorities for rural and urban networks
records.local_road_manager: Kenya Rural Roads Authority and Kenya Urban Roads Authority
records.asset_management_principles: Classified ownership, network inventory, planned maintenance and standards-based delivery
records.performance_measures: Condition, accessibility, maintenance delivery and authority-specific network performance
records.tools_and_techniques: Road inventory, maintenance manuals, surveys, GIS and programme monitoring

records.governance_model: Dedicated rural and urban roads agency operating through regional and district structures
records.lead_institution: President's Office - Regional Administration and Local Government / TARURA
records.local_road_manager: Tanzania Rural and Urban Roads Agency
records.financing_mechanism: Government, Roads Fund and development programmes
records.asset_management_principles: Local-road accessibility, maintainability, condition transparency and district accountability
records.performance_measures: Road condition by region and district; programme delivery and service access
records.tools_and_techniques: District Roads Management System (DROMAS), e-revenue system, condition reporting and GIS

records.governance_model: National road-development agency coordinating urban roads and local authorities
records.local_road_manager: RTDA with local authorities and other public agencies
records.financing_mechanism: Annual maintenance plans and project-based public financing
records.asset_management_principles: Condition- and traffic-led planning, cost-effectiveness, safety and infrastructure longevity
records.performance_measures: Condition, traffic, budget, maintenance actions, project schedule and financial delivery
records.tools_and_techniques: Condition monitoring, bridge inventory, contractor management, work scheduling and cash-flow databases
records.source_title: RTDA National and Urban Roads Division

records.governance_model: Three-sphere ownership across national, provincial and municipal road authorities
records.financing_mechanism: Provincial Roads Maintenance Grant and municipal/public-finance mechanisms
records.asset_management_principles: Statutory asset stewardship, consistent inventories, condition monitoring, lifecycle and financial accountability
records.performance_measures: Provincial and municipal RAMS data, road inventory updates, condition and grant performance
records.tools_and_techniques: TMH 22 RAMS, RRAMS, central repositories, surveys and annual/biannual analysis
records.source_title: South Africa TMH 22 Road Asset Management Manual

records.governance_model: National rural-road programme implemented by states through programme implementation units
records.local_road_manager: State rural roads agencies and programme implementation units
records.financing_mechanism: PMGSY programme financing with maintenance payments and state responsibilities
records.asset_management_principles: Connectivity, specification compliance, maintenance accountability, quality assurance and transparent delivery
records.performance_measures: Packages, road length, physical/financial progress, inspections, defects and maintenance payments
records.tools_and_techniques: OMMAS, eMARG, PMIS, mobile monitoring and independent quality monitors

records.governance_model: Local road-controlling authorities manage local roads within a co-funded national planning system
records.lead_institution: New Zealand Transport Agency Waka Kotahi
records.local_road_manager: Territorial local authorities and other road-controlling authorities
records.asset_management_principles: Evidence-based lifecycle planning, agreed service outcomes, resilience and single-source network data
records.performance_measures: Rehabilitation and resurfacing rates, pothole response, condition, delivery and customer outcomes
records.tools_and_techniques: Asset management plans, AMDS living centreline, 3/10-year programmes and quarterly reporting

records.governance_model: Federal performance rules with state risk-based asset plans and local ownership below state level
records.local_road_manager: State DOTs, counties, cities and other local public agencies
records.asset_management_principles: Risk-based planning, lifecycle cost, performance gaps, financial planning and investment strategy
records.performance_measures: Pavement and bridge inventory/condition, objectives, measures, targets, risks and investment outcomes
records.tools_and_techniques: Risk-based TAMPs, lifecycle planning, financial plans and performance monitoring

records.governance_model: Local highway authorities maintain local networks with central policy, formula grants and incentive funding
records.local_road_manager: County, unitary and metropolitan local highway authorities
records.financing_mechanism: Maintenance block formula allocation plus performance-linked incentive funding
records.asset_management_principles: Risk-based whole-life planning, transparency, best-practice maturity and local accountability
records.performance_measures: Condition, planned delivery, transparency, asset-management maturity and funding compliance
records.tools_and_techniques: Highway infrastructure asset-management plans, transparency reports, lifecycle plans and self-assessment
records.source_title: DfT local highway maintenance funding guidance
